goal: Ship the gated Gallery Page — a zero-JS photo grid fed by a build-time responsive-image pipeline, a native-feeling lightbox island, and a curated launch content pass — and prototype the invitation-derived layered background-pattern treatment on Home for the Team Lead's design ruling.

shipped.title: Pattern assets derived: muted duotone wall tile and full-color accents
shipped.summary: From the supplied seamless invitation tile, derive a muted forest/sage duotone wall tile at near-watermark contrast against cream (recolored toward Theme tokens) plus web-optimized full-color motif accents (fig, foliage, Golden Gate) for text-free zones; blend any visible seam; preserve the source tile under source material.
shipped.notes: Delivered public/pattern/{wall-tile,tile-full,motif-fig-branch,motif-bridge}.webp + docs/pattern-assets.md; all four acceptance criteria met (token-derived duotone tile, optimized full-color accents, no visible seam on 2x2 inspection, source preserved). Merged to branch sprint-3 at commit ea6e8b9 (merge 473eef7).

shipped.title: Image build pipeline: gallery masters become responsive variants and a manifest
shipped.summary: A prebuild script derives per-photo AVIF+WebP width ladders (capped at the master's intrinsic width, never upscaling), a blur placeholder, and intrinsic dimensions into a generated-variant manifest; content-hashed to skip unchanged masters; HEIC masters one-time converted to committed JPEG. Per ADR 019f3fba-e3d6: build-time processing, static serving, no runtime image service.
shipped.notes: All 5 acceptance criteria met: AVIF+WebP ladder capped at intrinsic width, manifest with dims+blur per photo, content-hash idempotent (0/10 on second pass), 8 new unit tests (102 total green), HEIC originals preserved + committed masters JPEG. Masters carried EXIF GPS; pipeline strips all metadata. Merged to branch sprint-3 at commit 720d893 (merge c0081d5).

shipped.title: Gallery Page walks: gated route, nav entry, zero-JS photo grid
shipped.summary: A new gated Gallery route renders a server-side justified-rows grid (two columns on mobile) from a section-capable photo manifest, shipping zero client JS, reserving each tile's aspect ratio (zero CLS), lazy-loading below-the-fold, with an edge gutter; nav gains Gallery between Travel and Registry; ships an initial demoable subset.
shipped.notes: All 6 acceptance criteria met. Gates: token-style PASS, prose-scrub PASS, design-reviewer PASS (0 blocking, 3 advisories in step_log). Merged to branch sprint-3 at commit c917014 (merge 61673a7); 107/107 tests green post-merge.

shipped.title: Home prototype of the layered pattern treatment, ending in the Team Lead's ruling
shipped.summary: On a preview deployment, Home only renders the layered treatment: the muted duotone tile as the page wall with content on solid cream panels echoing the invitation arch, plus full-color accents in text-free zones; no body text over the pattern, contrast measured against the cream panel, reduced-motion static. The Team Lead rules (layered/wall-only/accents-only/drop); the ruling is recorded and updates the site-wide rollout issue.
shipped.notes: Team Lead ACCEPTED round 2 (2026-07-07): wall candidate B — the full-color tile alpha-composited over token cream at 35%. Both design_direction_ruling entries plus the round-2 gate PASSes (token-style, design-reviewer) in step_log. Live-previewed at version 8dcdb963; merged to branch sprint-3 at commit 56748df (merge d83d452). The final ruling unblocks site-wide rollout 019f3fd3-f977.

shipped.title: Launch content pass: curated photo set, order, alt text, and captions
shipped.summary: With the Team Lead, confirm the shipped photo selection and order; content-steward writes alt text for every photo and captions where they add context, in the site's tone, carried by the photo manifest; no unconfirmed facts in captions. HITL slice — content-fidelity gate on the shipped words.
shipped.notes: All acceptance criteria met. Gates in order: content_fidelity_review_pass → process_review_pass (cycle 2, after the content_selection_ruling append closed the round-1 gap; all three verdicts in step_log). Team Lead content ruling recorded in step_log (content_selection_ruling): all 10 photos, order, section name, alt-only captions. Committed to branch sprint-3 at 412688d; 107/107 tests green.

shipped.title: Lightbox island: full-screen photo viewing with native-feeling gestures
shipped.summary: A dynamically-imported lightbox opens on first photo tap with swipe/pinch/tap gestures and visible arrow fallback, a hand-written single-history-entry back-button contract that restores grid scroll, and full a11y (focus trap/return, Escape, arrow keys, reduced-motion); styled exclusively via Theme tokens over the library's CSS variables.
shipped.notes: Gates: token-style PASS, design-reviewer PASS (0 blocking, 4 advisories in step_log). The A2/A4 on-device advisories were cleared by the Team Lead's phone pass (ship_ruling in step_log). Merged to branch sprint-3 at commit 54f7506 (merge 1aa2b52); 115/115 tests, lint clean on the integrated branch.

decisions.title: Site-wide pattern rollout stays out of Sprint 3
decisions.summary: The Team Lead ruled 019f3fd3-f977 (site-wide rollout of the ruled pattern treatment) out of Sprint 3 scope. It remains at the backlog root — not relocated into the sprint-3 partition — with actionable_now true (its dependency ruling on 019f3fd3-9a58 is final), as the highest-priority unpulled backlog item. Sprint 3 scope is final: 019f3fd2-fc03 (lightbox) and 019f3fd3-46ff (launch content pass) are the remaining in-flight items before close.

decisions.title: Generated gallery image output is committed, not regenerated in CI
decisions.summary: Per ADR 019f3fba-e3d6, the responsive AVIF/WebP variants and the generated-variant manifest are committed to the repo rather than regenerated during the CI build. The trade favors deploy correctness — the deployed output is the reviewed, content-hashed output — over repo size. Build-time processing, static serving, no runtime image service.

decisions.title: EXIF/GPS metadata is stripped from every committed photo master and variant
decisions.summary: The image pipeline strips all metadata, including EXIF GPS coordinates, from the committed JPEG masters and every derived variant. The supplied masters carried GPS; guest-facing gallery photos ship with no embedded location or camera data. This is a property of the pipeline, not a per-photo step.

decisions.title: Accepted invitation-pattern direction: layered, full-color wall at 35% over cream, no bands or motif
decisions.summary: The Team Lead's round-2 ruling on 019f3fd3-9a58 is the sprint's pattern decision of record: a layered treatment with the full-color invitation tile alpha-composited over token cream at 35% as the page wall, content on solid cream panels; the full-color accent bands and the bridge motif are dropped. The direction was confirmed on a real-device preview; the site-wide rollout 019f3fd3-f977, held out of this sprint, carries this direction.

retrospective_notes.title: The prototype → live-preview → ruling loop resolved the pattern direction in two rounds
retrospective_notes.body: The 019f3fd3-9a58 pattern prototype ran the prototype→live-preview→ruling loop twice, each round backed by a screenshots artifact and a 0%-traffic wrangler preview version; round 2 reached an accepted direction (wall candidate B — the full-color tile alpha-composited over token cream at 35%). The 0%-traffic preview-version pattern gave the Team Lead a real-device look on phone and desktop without touching production traffic.

retrospective_notes.title: Worktree-per-slice parallel builds ran conflict-free across five slices
retrospective_notes.body: Five Sprint-3 slices were built in parallel, each in its own git worktree, and integrated onto branch sprint-3 with zero merge conflicts. The worktree-per-slice isolation kept builders on disjoint file domains from racing on a shared index while several ran at once.

retrospective_notes.title: process-adherence caught a HITL approval that lived only in conversation
retrospective_notes.body: The 46ff launch-content ship-move FAILed process-adherence at round 1 because the Team Lead's photo selection/order approval existed only as an interactive answer, with no artifact on disk; content_fidelity_review_pass covered the wording, not the selection/order confirmation. Recording the content_selection_ruling in the step_log closed the gap and cycle 2 passed. The PROCESS.md write-the-ruling-before-work rule surfaced the gap between an approval given in conversation and an approval on the record.

retrospective_notes.title: A builder killed mid-slice by a session limit resumed cleanly from its worktree
retrospective_notes.body: One builder hit a session limit partway through its slice; because its work lived in an isolated git worktree, it resumed from that state and completed the slice with no lost or duplicated work.

retrospective_notes.title: Completion signals desynced from the Team Lead's view; disk-first verification prevented duplicate records
retrospective_notes.body: On three occasions the Team Lead reported a scribe write as undone — a step_log append or the four RSVP issues — when the files on disk already held it. The writes were uncommitted on branch sprint-3, so a committed or gate-side view lagged the working tree; scribe's completion messages had been sent each time. Reading the on-disk state before re-executing surfaced the true state on each occasion and prevented a duplicate step_log entry and four duplicate issue records. The corrective applied — trust the deployed state over message order — is the existing PROCESS.md rule.

Team Lead design-direction ruling (2026-07-07): LAYERED WITH TWEAKS. Accepted direction — the bridge motif is dropped from the hero panel; the arched hero photo is taller, filling the vacated space; both full-color accent bands are removed (the band-vs-wall two-toned contrast is rejected); the wall tile is regenerated with less severe muting so more original color reads through.
